title: Meet the Young Jewish Congresswoman Calling Out the UAE and Israel Over War Crimes
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
While politicians in the US are embroiled in [Donald
Trump's](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-insulted-
christians-9-times?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) seemingly
[endless wars](https://zeteo.com/p/iran-gaza-bajoghli-
erakat?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), Congresswoman **Sara
Jacobs** is pushing to end one that he did not start: the [war in
Sudan](https://zeteo.com/p/can-the-genocide-in-sudan-be-
stopped?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), which marked its third
anniversary on April 15. The top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs
Subcommittee on Africa was one of its first members to meet with Sudanese
refugees on the border of Chad when the war began, and three years later, she
is using her role to rein in US allies fueling the violence in Sudan.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" It's really hard to see how little attention this conflict is getting," **
says Jacobs, who is working to reintroduce a bill to[ prohibit US arms sales
to the United Arab Emirates](https://sarajacobs.house.gov/news/press-
releases/rep-sara-jacobs-sen-chris-van-hollen-reintroduce-bill-to-prohibit-us-
arms-sales-to-uae-until-they-cease-support-of-rsf-in-sudan) (UAE), believed to
be the main backer of Sudan's Rapid Support Forces (RSF), one of the two
warring parties in this conflict. **" We are the biggest seller of weapons to
the UAE. The UAE is the [biggest funder](https://www.theguardian.com/global-
development/2025/apr/14/leaked-un-experts-report-raises-fresh-concerns-over-
uaes-role-in-sudan-war) and armer of the RSF, which has been [found by our
State Department](https://sarajacobs.house.gov/news/press-releases/jacobs-van-
hollen-confirm-uae-providing-weapons-to-rsf-in-sudan-in-contradiction-to-its-
assurances-to-us) to have committed genocide."**

As the youngest Jewish member of Congress, Jacobs is also vocal in her
opposition to much of what [Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/israeli-settler-
violence-is-so-out?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) and the
Netanyahu government are [actively doing to
Palestinians](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-israel-
kills-f0b?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web) \- even if it costs her
friends in her own community. She tells **Mehdi** that her work on holding
Israel accountable for its war crimes has revealed the hypocrisy of many pro-
Israel Jewish organizations in the US that claim to stand on the side of all
Jewish people. **" I had a [GOP] colleague of mine literally make an
[antisemitic joke](https://forward.com/fast-forward/768826/i-have-a-good-
surgeon-if-you-ever-want-to-get-your-nose-done-gop-rep-nancy-mace-said-to-
jewish-progressive/) about my nose, and barely a peep from these
organizations."**

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/sudan-war-genocide-three-years-sara-jacobs-calls-
out-uae?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

The wide-ranging discussion touches on some of the biggest stories today,
including:

  * The UAE lobby in DC and how they **" literally lied to"** Jacobs' face, according to her.

  * Why Democrats didn't stop the war in Sudan under Biden's presidency.

  * Whether the US should continue to send so-called defensive weapons to Israel.

  * How Democrats can earn back voter trust after greenlighting the genocide in [Gaza](https://zeteo.com/p/zeteo-joins-the-gaza-flotilla-as?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web).

  * The plan for a permanent end to the war with Iran.

  * Whether California House Democrat Eric Swalwell's [sexual misconduct](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/reps-tony-gonzales-eric-swalwell-officially-resign-misconduct-claims-rcna331765) was an **" open secret"** in Congress.
